title: Fabula Ultima Shop & Economy
description: A JRPG-style shop for Project FU: buy, sell and buy back with automatic zenit, compare gear with what you have equipped, Inventory Point restocks, inns, haggling, Merchant class Trade Points, party funds and party stash, and level-appropriate stock generated from Project FU's compendiums.

recommends.reason: Its FFXIII / FFVII menu sounds play in the shop too.
